Punjabi Jotta – The Lion of Punjab 🦁🙏

A true son of Punjab, Punjabi Jotta raised his voice against the evil of drug abuse and started a mission to save the youth of Punjab. Although he is no longer among us, his courage, his mission, and his sacrifice will always remain alive in our hearts. ❤️🙏

Today, the entire Punjab stands firmly with Palwinder Jotta’s father and family during this heartbreaking time. We may not be able to bring back their beloved son, but we can stand beside them, share their pain, and pray for their strength and courage.

Dear Father, please never lose hope or courage. The entire Punjab is standing with you. You are not alone in this fight. May Waheguru Ji give you the strength to face this difficult time and grant eternal peace to your beloved son’s soul.

Punjabi Jotta will always be remembered as a brave son of Punjab who stood against drugs and fought for a better future for our youth. His mission must continue, and we must stand united against drugs with peace, courage, and determination.

May his soul rest in eternal peace. 🙏🕊️

Jai Hind! 🇮🇳 Jai Bharat! 🇮🇳
Punjab Stands With the Jotta Family. ❤️🙏
